notes: This is an internal API-contract probe, not normative conformance evidence. It observes whether a receive-order reflect callback already pending for HLA_EVOKED callback service is withdrawn after unsubscribe; no direct IEEE 1516.1-2025 requirement guaranteeing retraction of that queued callback has been identified. The C++ source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library, with the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration supplied by the adapter. Passing results record provider behavior only and must not be reported as IEEE 1516.1-2025 conformance.
